Home.treatmentBody: Patients travel to the clinic from across Cyprus, the United Kingdom and Germany. Consultations and procedures take place in Nicosia, in Greek, English or German.

Contact.metaDescription: Contact Dr Paris Papakostas — ENT, nose and sinus surgery in Nicosia, Cyprus. Phone, WhatsApp, email and clinic location.
Contact.bookBody: Choose a time that suits you and arrange your first appointment online. Every treatment begins with an in-person consultation, where your options, recovery and any risks are discussed in full.
